scenario.region_label: Fictional operator network placed in real Western Province towns (not real tower locations or coverage)

reports.text: CEB notice: planned power interruption in Bulathsinhala tomorrow 09:00-15:00 for line maintenance.
Call centre: 18 customers around Payagala say data is very slow and calls keep dropping.
Social media post: "heard the Minuwangoda tower is already fixed, the company van came" (unconfirmed).
NMS 06:00 | CRITICAL | MIN94 | RRU hardware fault, cells out of service
Bulletin 06:00 | Traffic police: Negombo to Minuwangoda route blocked, vehicles turned back

policy.evidence_rule: Authoritative evidence must be consistent; equally authoritative conflicts require confirmation. Recency alone does not verify a fact.
policy.on_crew_loss: Pause affected unfinished work and request operator review; preserve completed repairs.

limitations: no in-progress work or future-event scheduling

ignored_reports.note: Planned future power interruption in Bulathsinhala; no mapped site or current operational claim.
Customer complaint reports slow data and dropped calls around Payagala but makes no specific asset claim.
Unconfirmed social-media rumour that the Minuwangoda tower is fixed; it does not establish an operational claim and conflicts with no authoritative evidence.

finding.finding: Authoritative evidence indicates Minuwangoda equipment is not working and the Negombo–Minuwangoda road is blocked. No grid-power or backhaul claim is established.

S17 has a verified equipment fault; R17 is verified closed. Other listed sites and links have no resolved faults. Crews with equipment skills are available, and the catalogue includes an equipment repair for S17. The closed road blocks the direct S16–S17 route, but the supplied road data shows an alternate route via S15; no action is shown to be unsafe or impossible, so no defer request is warranted. Generator deployment is not indicated because no site has a resolved grid-power fault.

S04 (Matugama) is the only service with policy-approved critical weight 5; all other services have weight 1. The currently evidenced outage is at S17 (Minuwangoda): authoritative NMS evidence reports an RRU hardware fault and cells out of service, so S17 matters as a confirmed standard-weight outage. The Negombo–Minuwangoda route is also reported blocked, which may constrain access, but does not change service priority. No credible supplied evidence supports changing any service’s approved priority.

limitations: no in-progress work or future-event scheduling
